summary: The ProgramYearType class manages program year data, particularly providing lists of program years based on session configurations or specific program IDs.
purpose: To generate and manage lists of program years for various programs in an HSPnet session, facilitating configurations and lookups for maximum allowable program years.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: The code representing the program year

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The value associated with the program year

workflows.name: Generate Program Year List
steps: Lookup max program year from configuration
If maxProgramYear is parsed, build a list from 1 to maxProgramYear

workflows.name: Generate Program Year List for Program
steps: Determine total years for the program
Build a list from 1 to ProgramTotalYears

business_rules: Program year lists must start from 1 and go up to the max program year or the total years for a specific program.
'Not Applicable' is represented with the code '0' and added at the end of each list.
validations: Session must be valid for operations that require configuration lookup.
ProgramID must exist in the database when generating lists specific to a program.
calculations: ProgramTotalYears is determined by truncating the total years value of the program.
conditions: If maxProgramYear cannot be parsed, a default list up to 5 years is used.
system_behavior: The system retrieves configuration data to determine max program years.
The system accesses program details by ID to determine the total years for a specific program.
exceptions: When session is null, default program year list up to 5 is used.
